name: bonfire_survivors
prompt: Create one transparent pixel-art sprite asset for a northern dark-fantasy survival game: exactly FOUR distinct adult civilian survivors wrapped in heavy worn charcoal, slate blue, muted brown and faded olive cloaks. One older man, one hooded woman, two tired adults, no weapons. Arrange them as a low, wide group, two on the left, two on the right, seated or crouched, facing inward toward an EMPTY CENTRAL SPACE. Composition intended for a 128x64 game canvas: leave the full middle 36 pixels horizontally completely transparent for the existing separate campfire shown in reference; survivors occupy only left x4..44 and right x84..123. No fire, embers, light source, wood pile, ground, circle, text or scenery in output. Foot bottoms on a common bottom baseline, 2px padding. Figures around 40-48 pixels tall in game space, three-quarter overhead view like reference, hard square pixels, compact readable silhouettes, cold shadows, top-left neutral lighting, <=48 muted colors. References show the existing game's pixel shading and existing fire to leave room for, do not copy fire into output.
